name: EU Business School - Geneva campus
summary: Private business school with a campus in Geneva; seven three-year bachelor's taught in English, with four start dates a year.

ib.text: Its admission page lists an IB Diploma with at least 24 points. Bachelor's also need English at B2 (IELTS 6.0, TOEFL 80) unless you are a native speaker or equivalent, two references and an essay.

apply.via: EU Business School online application (CHF 200 fee)

programmes.name: Bachelor of Business Administration
programmes.selectionNote: Rolling admission: an advisor reviews your file (essay, two references), you have a personal assessment interview, and the decision comes within a week of your documents.
programmes.about: A broad business degree from project management and data analysis to branding and digital communication, with an internship, the chance to move between EU campuses and a summer fast track.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts in International Relations
programmes.selectionNote: Rolling admission: an advisor reviews your file (essay, two references), you have a personal assessment interview, and the decision comes within a week of your documents.
programmes.about: The interplay of politics, economics and culture across borders, from geopolitics and conflict to policy strategy and diplomatic negotiation, studied in Geneva with an internship.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts in Artificial Intelligence for Business
programmes.selectionNote: Rolling admission: an advisor reviews your file (essay, two references), you have a personal assessment interview, and the decision comes within a week of your documents.
programmes.about: Machine learning, data analytics and automation applied to business processes and strategy, aimed at leading AI-driven change in companies, with an internship.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts in Sports Management
programmes.selectionNote: Rolling admission: an advisor reviews your file (essay, two references), you have a personal assessment interview, and the decision comes within a week of your documents.
programmes.about: The business side of sport: sponsorship, negotiation, communication, finance, logistics and digital change in the sports industry, e-sports included, with an internship.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts in Digital Business, Design & Innovation
programmes.selectionNote: Rolling admission: an advisor reviews your file (essay, two references), you have a personal assessment interview, and the decision comes within a week of your documents.
programmes.about: User-centred digital design and entrepreneurship for leading digital transformation, brand and change management, with an internship.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts in Leisure & Tourism Management
programmes.selectionNote: Rolling admission: an advisor reviews your file (essay, two references), you have a personal assessment interview, and the decision comes within a week of your documents.
programmes.about: Service quality, event management and sustainable tourism, with business models and financial analysis for travel and leisure, an internship and exchanges with sister schools in Paris, Bordeaux, Lyon, Monaco and London.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Business Finance
programmes.selectionNote: Rolling admission: an advisor reviews your file (essay, two references), you have a personal assessment interview, and the decision comes within a week of your documents.
programmes.about: Financial institutions and instruments, risk management, profitability and financial data analysis on an ethical footing, aimed at banking, accountancy and business intelligence, with an internship.

notes: Each Geneva bachelor's leads to EU's own accredited degree, a university-specific degree from UVic-UCC in Spain and a state-recognised BA (Hons) in Business Management from the University of Derby.
Programmes start in October, February, June and August, and decisions come within a week of your documents and interview.
The BBA packs seven semesters (240 ECTS) into three years, and every programme offers an optional extra semester for a Diploma of Advanced Studies.
